title: Polisher Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah
description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someoneâs day. When you join our Hotels team, thatâs exactly what youâll do every time you come to work! As a Polisher, and finishes are well-maintained and visually appealing â youâre spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

Essential Functions

  • Apply polishing paints and coatings to various surfaces throughout the hotel, including floors, walls, and furniture.
  • Prepare surfaces for polishing by cleaning, sanding, or buffing as needed to ensure optimal adhesion and finish.
  • Select appropriate polishing paints and coatings based on surface type, usage, and desired appearance.
  • Use painting and polishing equipment such as brushes, rollers, sprayers, and polishing machines safely and effectively.
  • Apply polishing paints and coatings evenly and accurately to achieve a smooth and consistent finish.
  • Follow manufacturer instructions and safety guidelines when handling and applying polishing paints and coatings.
  • Inspect finished surfaces for quality and touch up any imperfections or inconsistencies as necessary.
  • Coordinate with other members of the engineering team to schedule and prioritize polishing projects.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment, including proper storage and disposal of painting and polishing materials.
  • Adhere to health and safety regulations while working with painting and polishing chemicals and equipment.
  • Communicate effectively with engineering supervisors and colleagues regarding project progress and any issues encountered.
  • Stay updated on new polishing techniques, materials, and equipment to enhance skills and efficiency.

SUPPORTIVE FUNTIONS

  • In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the supervisor based upon the particular requirements of the company
  • Providing input on material selection for optimal results.
  • Collaborating with other departments for scheduling projects.
  • Keeping records of materials used and project progress.
  • Collaborate with carpenters and other maintenance staff to assist in the repair or refurbishment of items before polishing, when necessary.
  • Supporting colleagues with tasks as needed.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member.

Specific Job Knowledge, Skills And Ability

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

  • Proven experience and expertise in polishing, with a thorough understanding of techniques and methods for different surfaces.
  • Proficient in using hand tools and power tools relevant to polishing work.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to achieve high-quality finishes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

LICENSES OR CERTIFICATE

  • Painting and Decorating Certificate
  • Manufacturer Training Certification
  • Hazardous Materials Handling Certification
  • CPR Certification and/or First Aid Training is an advantageous

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we donât just deliver exceptional experiences for our guestsâwe build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, weâve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the Worldâs Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, weâre setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether youâre starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the careerâand help us make every stay a little more magical.

title: Aviation Maintenance Technician
description:
To provide safe and efficient routine and non-routine maintenance to FedEx aircraft, under some supervision, in accordance with FedEx policies ad procedures, as well as FAA regulations.

Education and Qualification: Diploma and equivalent. Qualification: Current Federal Aviation Administration Airfare & Power plant (A&P) certificate required Experience: Two (2) years of Aircraft Maintenance experience as an aircraft mechanic including one (1) year experience on aircraft types and equipment similar to the FedEx fleet.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Our Company

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 Worldâs Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

Our Philosophy

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

Our Culture

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970âs. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in todayâs global marketplace.
